recent_posts.title: Windows quality update: Progress we’ve made since March
recent_posts.summary: Microsoft's Windows Insider Program lead shares a progress update on quality improvements shipped since March 2026. Key changes include a restructured Insider Program with two channels (Experimental and Beta), reduced Windows Update disruptions via consolidated monthly restarts, removal of Copilot buttons from Snipping Tool and Photos, File Explorer performance and stability improvements, calmer Widgets and Discover feed defaults, and system-wide memory and responsiveness optimizations including scheduler improvements. Taskbar customization is teased as coming soon.

recent_posts.title: Announcing new builds for 1 May 2026 and extending ISO support
recent_posts.summary: Microsoft is releasing new Windows 11 Insider Preview builds across Beta and Experimental channels. Key highlights include: ISO download support is being extended to all Beta and Experimental channel builds, a refreshed Run dialog with modern visuals is available as opt-in in the Experimental channel, Feedback Hub is updated to version 2.2604.301.0 with reliability and accessibility improvements, and Widgets will now be quiet by default with hover-open and taskbar badging disabled. New build numbers include 26220.8340 (Beta), 26300.8346 (Experimental), 28020.1921 (Experimental 26H1), and 29580.1000 (Experimental Future Platforms).

recent_posts.title: We’re moving to Experimental and Beta! Announcing new builds for 24 April 2026
recent_posts.summary: Microsoft is restructuring the Windows Insider Program by replacing the existing Dev, Beta, and Canary channels with new 'Experimental' and 'Beta' channels. The transition begins today with Dev Channel users moving to Experimental, followed by Canary and Beta channel users in the coming weeks. Insiders can manually enable the new Experimental UI via Feature flags in Settings before the automatic rollout. Beta Channel users may notice minor feature changes after transition and are advised to move to Dev/Experimental beforehand for best continuity. Release notes are also moving to the Windows Insider Program Documentation Hub for improved navigation, dark/light mode, localization, and deep linking.

recent_posts.title: Windows Update gets more user controls and fewer monthly reboots
recent_posts.summary: Microsoft is rolling out several improvements to the Windows Update experience based on user feedback. Key changes include: the ability to skip updates during initial device setup (OOBE), extended and unlimited pause controls with a calendar picker (up to 35 days, re-pausable indefinitely), a redesigned Power menu that always shows plain Restart/Shut down options separate from update-specific actions, and clearer driver update titles with device class labels. Additionally, Microsoft is unifying driver, .NET, and firmware updates to align with the monthly quality update cycle, aiming to reduce restarts to once per month. Background improvements include faster update downloads, automatic recovery from installation failures, and faster app restoration after restarts.

recent_posts.title: Announcing Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 28020.1863 (Canary Channel)
recent_posts.summary: Microsoft has released Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 28020.1863 to the Canary Channel. This build includes a fix for an issue that prevented some apps from signing in due to a false report of no internet connectivity, along with general improvements and fixes. The release also includes a small set of improvements rolled out via Control Feature Rollout technology. Standard Canary Channel reminders apply, including build instability warnings and the requirement for a clean install to exit the channel.

recent_posts.title: Announcing Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26220.8271 (Beta Channel)
recent_posts.summary: Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26220.8271 (KB 5083728) has been released to the Beta Channel. This build is based on Windows 11 version 25H2 via an enablement package. Gradual rollout improvements include clearer UI for disabled location settings, better reliability for Settings > Apps > Installed apps, updated File Explorer search box iconography, improved File Explorer reliability and Voice Access navigation, better Windows Hello fingerprint performance after sleep, faster clipboard history opening, and font updates for Thai, Lao, Khmer, and Lontara scripts in the Leelawadee UI font family.

recent_posts.title: Releasing Windows 11 Builds 26100.8313 and 26200.8313 to the Release Preview Channel
recent_posts.summary: Windows 11 Builds 26100.8313 and 26200.8313 are now available to Release Preview Channel Insiders for versions 24H2 and 25H2. Key additions include Xbox mode for PCs (full-screen gaming interface), File Explorer improvements (faster launch, dark mode fixes, new archive format support including nupkg), haptic feedback for compatible input devices, a new taskbar agents monitoring API, enhanced batch file security via a registry lock setting, and a Windows driver policy change removing default trust for cross-signed drivers. Storage improvements include raising the FAT32 format limit from 32GB to 2TB via command line. Enterprise features include expanded policy-based app removal and Enterprise State Roaming management via Windows Backup for Organizations.

recent_posts.title: Announcing Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26300.8276 (Dev Channel)
recent_posts.summary: Microsoft has released Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26300.8276 (KB 5083726) to the Dev Channel. This build is based on Windows 11 version 25H2 via an enablement package. Gradual rollout improvements include clearer UI for location settings (greyed-out options when Location services is off), improved reliability for navigating to Installed Apps in Settings, updated File Explorer search box iconography, improved File Explorer reliability and Voice Access navigation pane support, better Windows Hello fingerprint reliability after sleep, improved clipboard history performance, and font updates for Thai, Lao, Khmer, and Lontara scripts in the Leelawadee UI font family.

recent_posts.title: Announcing Windows 11 Insider Preview Build for Canary Channel 29570.1000
recent_posts.summary: Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 29570.1000 is now available in the Canary Channel. Key additions include Xbox mode for PCs (full-screen gaming interface accessible via Win+F11), expanded policy-based removal of preinstalled Microsoft apps for Enterprise/Education via Group Policy, context menu icon matching for executable files, a configurable right-click zone size setting for touchpads, expanded lock screen widget personalization rolling out globally, and a new pen tail button option to match the Copilot key behavior.

recent_posts.title: Announcing Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 28020.1812 (Canary Channel)
recent_posts.summary: Microsoft has released Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 28020.1812 to the Canary Channel. Key changes include a new touchpad setting to customize the right-click zone size (default, small, medium, or large), refinements to the drag tray sharing feature with a smaller peek view to reduce accidental invocations, and enhancements to the Windows Security app's Secure Boot section with color-coded status badges and certificate status visibility. The Feedback Hub has also been updated to version 2.2604.101.0 with design improvements including better default window sizing, session-persistent window size, mouse back button navigation, and fixes for community feedback display and upvote buttons for Chinese language users.
